To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the literature search process in IS literature reviews is not sufficiently documented, that this process is crucial for reconstructing the giant of accumulated IS knowledge, and that we need to be more rigorous in documenting the literature review and search process in order to improve the quality of IS research.

the process of literature searching is not comprehensibly described in many literature reviews published in top IS journals, that the literature search process is not documented in a consistent way, and that many reviews do not follow established search strategies and guidelines.
(i) the literature search is the foundation of a literature review and that (ii) the process of searching literature must be documented in a comprehensible way.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quality of research and its impact on the scientific community.
the question of how to write a literature review that can be reproduced and re-used by other scholars.
how to reconstruct the giant in the field and how to make the process of doing so more explicit and reproducible.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the process of literature searching in IS is not sufficiently documented and that this needs to be improved.
the literature review process should be comprehensively described in a literature review article, and this description should follow the proposed guidelines.
a literature search is a necessary first step in a literature review, but not a sufficient condition for a high-quality review.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the literature search process must be documented in a way that is comprehensible and reproducible for others.
we want to contribute to the reconstruction of the IS giant.
we are calling for more rigour when writing literature reviews and that we provide guidelines on how to conduct a literature review and literature search in the IS research field.

a literature review is not a mere summary, it is a reconstruction of the giant's skeleton.
researchers need to be more transparent in documenting their literature search process.
